sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Type / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: In a spreadsheet, which symbol is used to create an absolute cell reference to prevent a row or column from shifting when copied?
Which view is used to apply a consistent background and font style across all slides in a digital presentation?
What type of cyberattack involves sending fraudulent emails disguised as a reputable source to steal passwords?
Which spreadsheet function is used to find the highest numerical value in a selected range of cells?
What term describes the visual effect that occurs when moving from one slide to the next during a presentation?
True or False: Antivirus software can completely protect a computer from all future zero-day cyber threats without requiring any online updates.
What feature allows you to temporarily hide rows in a spreadsheet that do not meet specific criteria, displaying only the relevant data?
Which of the following constitutes a strong password policy for personal online accounts?
options: A) Using your exact date of birth
B) Using a mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols
C) Using the same password for all websites
questions.answer: B) Using a mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols

questions.question_text: Which keyboard shortcut is typically used to start a digital presentation from the very first slide?
Which type of chart in an electronic spreadsheet is best suited to display data as percentages of a whole?
Define the term 'malware' and name two common types that can infect a computer system. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Malware is malicious software designed to disrupt, damage, or gain unauthorized access to a computer system. Common types include viruses, trojans, worms, and spyware.

questions.question_text: Explain the purpose of using a 'Slide Master' in a digital presentation software application. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A Slide Master is a top-level template that stores layout, theme, font styles, and background properties, ensuring uniform formatting across all slides in the presentation.

questions.question_text: Differentiate between the 'Sorting' and 'Filtering' features in an electronic spreadsheet environment. [25-35 words]
questions.answer: Sorting rearranges data sequentially in ascending or descending order. Filtering temporarily hides rows that do not meet specified criteria, allowing users to view only specific, relevant data points.

questions.question_text: What is multi-factor authentication (MFA) and why is it important for personal cyber safety? [25-35 words]
questions.answer: MFA is a security mechanism requiring two or more verification methods to access an account. It adds an extra layer of protection if a password gets stolen or compromised.

questions.question_text: Write the exact formula to calculate the total sum of values in cells C4, C5, C6, and C7 using a predefined function. [15-25 words]
questions.answer: To calculate the total sum of that specific range, you should use the function formula: =SUM(C4:C7) in the destination cell.

questions.question_text: Describe the process of adding custom animation to a specific text box in a slide and setting it to trigger 'On Click'. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Select the text box, navigate to the 'Animations' tab, and choose a desired entrance effect. Open the animation pane, right-click the effect, and select 'Start On Click' to trigger the animation manually during the slideshow.

questions.question_text: Explain how the AutoFill feature works in a spreadsheet and provide an example of how it can save time during data entry. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: AutoFill automatically populates a range of cells with a recognized pattern or sequential data by dragging the fill handle. For example, typing 'Monday' and dragging it down automatically fills in 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', saving manual typing time.

questions.question_text: Case: A student receives a pop-up warning that her computer is infected, prompting her to download a 'free scanner' immediately. Identify this cyber threat and outline three immediate steps she should take to secure her system. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: This is scareware, a deceptive tactic designed to trick users into downloading malicious software. She should immediately close the browser window using keyboard shortcuts (Alt+F4), avoid clicking anything within the pop-up, disconnect from the internet, and run a full system scan using her installed, trusted antivirus software.

questions.question_text: Case: A teacher has a spreadsheet containing 50 student marks in Column C. She needs to identify students who scored below 40 without manually checking each row. Detail the spreadsheet tool she should use and the steps to apply it. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The teacher should use Conditional Formatting. She must select the marks in Column C, click 'Conditional Formatting' in the Home tab, choose 'Highlight Cells Rules', and select 'Less Than'. She then enters '40' and applies a red fill format to instantly highlight all failing students automatically.
